purpose: Source-backed migration ledger; proposed replacements, not implemented. No source/test edits or execution. Each normal Go Test function and each authored Bun test declaration needs a row; TestMain/helpers and executable browser/native drivers need separate support/scenario rows. Dynamic rows must name dimensions and preserve qualified scope. Static files will get a separate exhaustive file map.

row_fields.kind: go_test | bun_test | scenario | support | caller | historical
row_fields.symbol: exact Go function name or Bun test title/expression or support name
row_fields.protects: array of concrete behavior obligations; split facets of large tests, avoid only restating test name
row_fields.observes: array of current measurement/oracle mechanisms with native independence where needed
row_fields.variants: array dynamic subtest/browser/service dimensions; [] when none
row_fields.gates: array env vars/dependencies/skip conditions, [] if none
row_fields.replacement: specific proposed Can scenario/helper behavior, no invented available API names
row_fields.disposition: migrate | consolidate | historical_candidate | preserve_record | retain_fixture | replace_support | rewire
row_fields.delete_when: specific evidence/caller conditions before host code removal; historical candidates evidence before retirement, no automatic deletion
row_fields.related_sources: array repository paths of called browser scripts/driver fixtures/runtime test oracles, [] if none
row_fields.notes: remaining gaps or historical relevance, no claim implemented/tested

capabilities.SUITE: Can registration/selection/policy, case reports and coverage scopes
capabilities.CAN: compile and execute ordinary Can and existing attached assertions
capabilities.WORK: owned temp workspaces, build reuse, cleanup/recovery
capabilities.NATIVE: independent raw host/native observations or fault construction
capabilities.CHILD: owned running processes, readiness observations, descriptors, signals, wait
capabilities.FAULT: seeded bad programs/runtime/report faults and mutant sensitivity
capabilities.PEER: controllable loopback peer/stub with Can-authored response policy and request/arrival observations
capabilities.CLOCK: bounded wait, monotonic elapsed-time and controllable timing observations
capabilities.METRIC: process RSS/resource observations for explicitly authorized qualification

instructions: Write only your owned JSON fragment, top-level {rows:[...]}. Read source bodies and called scripts; do not infer coverage from test names alone. Capture every required source function exactly once. Protect grouped tests full behavior: diagnostics plus production build identity/output/runtime delegates. For delegated runtime suites, map protected obligations, not a proposed Can subprocess around bun test. Historic candidates need source justification, no unilateral retirement. All rows remain proposed; old harness deletion only after parity evidence/caller migration. Backend open; ordinary Can helpers required. Need not consult Jev just to extract facts/record conditional options; escalate genuinely new difficult design choices to root.
